# deps: brew: problem with plumber installation

Fix `brew bundle` failing on the `plumber` formula ([[DOT-160]]) from the vendor tap:

```
Installing batchcorp/public/plumber
Warning: 'batchcorp/public/plumber' formula is unreadable: batchcorp/public/plumber: undefined method `Architecture' for OS:Module
Installing plumber formula. It is not currently installed.
Error: batchcorp/public/plumber: undefined method `Architecture' for OS:Module
Installing batchcorp/public/plumber has failed!
```

The tap's formula used a Homebrew Ruby API (`OS::Architecture`) that had been removed, so the formula could not even be parsed; since `brew bundle` processes the whole file, one broken third-party formula made every `install`/`self-update brew` report failure.
